The claim conflates the total propagator (which includes unscattered light) with the integral term (which represents only the single-scattered light). Thus, while some facts are present (integration over intermediate positions and outgoing directions for the scattered part), the claim that the *entire* product is integrated over these variables to form the summation described is inaccurate because it ignores the separate unscattered term and mischaracterizes the scope of the integration.
